column1: # Lexeme class `person`: nouns that name people, groups of people and animals, for the choice
# of the relative pronoun (`who` for people, `which` for things; `that` for both) and other
# rules that need to know whether a noun can name a person. Own work (clean-room): written from
# own knowledge of English over the nouns of this lexicon, ordered by our own frequency counts.
#   human   a person in its usual sense (`teacher`, `friend`, `neighbor`): `who`/`that`;
#   group   a group or institution of people (`team`, `family`, `government`, `company`):
#   animal  an animal (`dog`, `horse`): `which`/`that`, `who` for pets and characters
#   mixed   a person in one use and a thing in another (`driver` = person or software,
# Nouns not listed are taken as things only by rules that say so (`the book who`).
# Format: Heinrich docs/LEXICON_FORMAT_EN.md §14 (lemma, part of speech, value).
